propositions: Introduce .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file to persist GET-rotation state, reading max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) for each Jira key during dual-write rollout
Implement fail-open rotation module with load/save accessors that dual-write every new timestamp to both sidecar and legacy inline field until A2-2 removes legacy write
A pass with no absent-key GETs after rotation initialization must leave all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and not advance HEAD
A pass with absent-key GETs must advance the same Jira-key stamps in get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, and commit both files via explicit local staging
Interleaved old-binary/new-binary pass sequences must produce equivalent rotation order to all-new sequences via max()-based lookup and dual-write persistence
Module size contract: outbound_differ.py must remain at or below 800 lines after extracting existing outbound wrappers
